purpose: Check prerequisites before freezing a new natural-agent experiment. This is not an executable trial preregistration or fresh performance evidence.

limitations: Current exec JSONL has turn-level aggregate usage; internal provider requests and retries are not counted.
Provider tokens become available at turn completion; prior thresholds were exceeded.
Actual subscription charges and actual serving model identity are unverified. Requested model is recorded, not asserted as provider identity.

comparison.cache_conditions: Proposed: isolated per-attempt source copies and indexes, sequential arms in frozen randomized order; shared warm OS/dependency caches and uncontrolled provider cache. Count cached provider input tokens in primary total.
comparison.note: Repetition count and seed are preparation defaults, not an inferential design. Freeze sample size, task outcomes, margins, severe loss limits and paired rule before any new data.

broker_contract.all_payloads: Preserve initial issue/schema/orientation, requests, responses, refusals, failures and native output overruns. Separately report local cl100k payload counts and provider totals.
broker_contract.graphify: Pinned native code-only hints followed by the same source read/search/edit/test tools. No documentation-task or source-anchor claim from hints.
broker_contract.timing: Proposed shared attempt boundary: orientation through unconditional final verification; report index construction separately and count it for end-to-end setup.

historical_constraints.codex_v3: Stopped; may_resume false. Do not raise limits, replace attempts, or pool with a new batch.
historical_constraints.v64: Retrieval results unchanged. Now exposed; cannot be reused as unseen confirmation after tuning.

provenance_note: Graphify sources are an exported archive, not a Git checkout. invalid-git-probe.json is retained: git -C inherited the parent Graf repository and is not baseline provenance. Installed Python sources passed equality against the exported snapshot; archive pin comes from the preserved snapshot receipt.
